summary: Assess ICS risk, apply IEC 62443 concepts, and plan OT response through sector scenarios. Explore the five-day course.
lede: ICS cybersecurity management helps industrial teams assess control-system risks while balancing safety and operational availability. For OT security managers, plant engineers, CISOs with OT responsibility, and IT/OT leads, it develops skills in asset and risk assessment, threat modelling, and network segmentation. Learners also draft incident-response plans, map security ownership, and prioritize improvements, with AI-assisted monitoring covered at an operational awareness level.
audienceIntro: This ICS cybersecurity course is designed for professionals who make or inform security decisions affecting industrial operations, control systems, and critical infrastructure.
modules: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS Threat Modelling
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with IT or OT operations, industrial processes, cybersecurity, or plant engineering is recommended. No programming is required. The course addresses IEC 62443 implementation concepts and AI-assisted OT monitoring at an operational planning level; it does not train you to engineer or deploy production security systems.
